coreLoop.playerOutcome: Reconstruct Driv3r city action around control sampling, actor/world updates and proximity activation. Vehicle driving, contact response and camera ownership remain explicit missing work; the available prefab only prepares proximity records.

phases.label: Sample held and newly pressed controls
gaps: No portable MMIO sampler or vehicle/actor button mapping is supplied.
phases.observation: Original04d08 reads KEYINPUT, inverts10bits, derives held and rising-edge masks; caller runs it before04dd4.

phases.label: Translate controls into vehicle/actor requests
gaps: Throttle/brake/steering/on-foot mapping is not proven.
Retained04dd4 decompilation has boundary/mode failures; do not treat it as a complete driving controller.
phases.observation: Source scheduler reaches04dd4 after input; initial bytes show guarded counters and a source service, not a recovered vehicle controller.

phases.label: Integrate vehicle and actor motion
gaps: No native-qualified Driv3r movement or vehicle dynamics producer exists.
Proximity consumers use fixed-point source positions, but consumption does not prove their producer.
phases.observation: Position values are observed by the activation scanner; no source-complete motion transfer is claimed.

phases.label: Discover nearby source world records
gaps: Nested profile offsets/lookup domains and loop lifetimes are unqualified.
Nearby grid/object discovery is not proof of collision response.
phases.observation: b67a0 scans25 nearby grid cells from shifted X/Z, collects up to32 entries and materializes up to8 source records under descriptor flags.

phases.label: Resolve vehicle/world contacts
gaps: No source-qualified vehicle contact manifold, response, crash or damage transaction is provided.
phases.observation: Spatial grid data exists; physical contact semantics remain unestablished.

phases.label: Prepare primary and secondary proximity requests
gaps: Raw profile words remain private source-format context with fixed validation payloads.
These requests do not instantiate/render actors or execute distance activation.
phases.observation: Original adjacent allocators share one16-record pool; primary then secondary suppress duplicate selectors and choose first empty slot, otherwise slot0.

phases.label: Update source proximity record flags
gaps: Source service closure and full profile domains are not qualified.
phases.observation: Original33b8 compares profile X/Z against actor position, updates guards and seven record descriptor flags; called before activation.

phases.label: Check proximity and activate selected record
gaps: Scanner and service closure are not executable prefabs.
Resource initialization512-store VRAM loop exceeds current default bounded expansion.
phases.observation: Source scanner retires distant entries, gates input/range/flags, snapshots actor state and sets type-specific channels after the two allocation calls and updater.

phases.label: Project and present the city scene
gaps: No qualified camera/projection contract or complete render boundary has been identified.
Resource VRAM clearing is not a recovered camera or renderer.
phases.observation: The caller invokes further scene services; their camera/render ownership is not inferred from addresses.

phases.label: Persist mission/session progress and recover
gaps: Source progress events and save compatibility are not connected to this prefab.
phases.observation: No mission-completion or whole-session recovery claim.
